patterns: APPSC asks direct identification: GMO regulator = GEAC (distractors FSSAI, CPCB, ICAR); GEAC under EPA 1986 / MoEFCC.
GM crop facts recur: Bt brinjal = pest (fruit and shoot borer) resistance, GM mustard DMH-11 = Delhi University, Golden rice = transgenic/beta-carotene, Bt gene from Bacillus thuringiensis.
APPSC adds a current-affairs twist (states where farmers defied bans: Maharashtra, Haryana).
UPSC-style multi-statement items on Bt brinjal resistance and GM food import are the deepest PYQs seen.
App MCQs go far deeper (SDN categories, committee tiers, PepsiCo case, BSL levels, BWC) - sound but well beyond APPSC depth.
